capabilities: Move notes to an archive folder once they reach a specified age
Configure which notes are archived, their destination, and the age threshold
extras: The README credits the Period Notes plugin and links to support its author.
intentEvidence: This plugin uses code from the Period Notes plugin by Liam Cain.
motivation: The author built it because they were tired of manually dragging daily notes to an archive.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to automatically move aged notes (like old daily notes) to an archive, forcing manual dragging.

relations.evidence: This plugin uses code from the Period Notes plugin by Liam Cain.

summary: Auto-archiving plugin that moves notes to a chosen archive folder once they reach a configurable age.
